label: D2: reached S2 after an unrewarded previous trial
explanation: Reset-gate unit that fires almost only at D2 (91% of activation mass) and only when the reached state is S2 (never at D2 with S1; never at GO). Within S2 D2 steps it is gated mainly by the previous trial being unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 90% of mass; rate after a rewarded previous trial is low). A small remainder (~9% mass) is weak D1 activity, mostly on the D1 right after such an S2 D2 step. Every variable used is observed at D2. Predicate (D2 & S2 & prev unrewarded) has dev recall 0.80 and mass recall 0.90, but precision only 0.45: about half of the matching steps stay below threshold. Activation is stronger early in the episode (rate falls steadily from trials 0-9 to 90-99; adding ep_trial<50 raises precision to 0.64 but cuts mass recall to 0.63). Neither the action (a1 vs a2), the transition type, the hidden good state, reward two trials back, value, nor policy logit separated active from inactive steps cleanly. No causal analysis done.
